blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-Image (T2I) models turn short text descriptions into images, and the leading models now produce images of comparable visual quality. Whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics matters for attribution, for model comparison beyond aggregate quality, and for evaluations that assume anonymity. We ask whether images from frontier T2I models can still be classified by source, and which visual properties make this possible. Here we show that a standard ResNet-50 identifies the source of an image among HiDream-O1-Dev, FLUX.2-dev, HunyuanImage-3.0, and Qwen-Image-2512, the four highest-ranked open-source models on the Text-to-Image Arena, with 100.00% accuracy on held-out prompts. Human participants reach only 62.61% on the pairwise version of this task, so the distinguishing cues are not visually obvious. They are also not tied to a particular classifier and survive severe image corruptions and out-of-distribution prompts. We trace them to visual idiosyncrasies at three levels. Low-level texture statistics alone let a lightweight multi-layer perceptron match ResNet-50. Object layout, depth, and albedo estimated from the images each carry a source signal. Image captions reveal model-specific preferences in style and background that the prompts never specify. A one-sentence hint about these cues raises human accuracy by 9.03 percentage points. These idiosyncrasies make source classification a tool for measuring similarity between models and between real and generated images, and they caution against assuming anonymity in human preference evaluation of T2I models.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像(T2I)模型将短文本描述转换为图像,现在领先模型产生具有可比较视觉质量的图像. 其产出是否仍然具有特定模式的特点,涉及归属、超出总体质量的模型比较以及匿名评价。 我们询问来自边疆T2I模型的图像是否能够仍然按照源头进行分类,以及哪些视觉特性使得这成为可能. 在这里,我们显示一个标准的ResNet-50在HiDream-O1-Dev,FLUX.2-dev,Hunyuanimage-3.0和Quen-Image-2512中识别出一个图像的来源,这是Text-to-Image Arena上的四个排名最高的开源模型,在被搁置的提示上精确度为100.0%. 人类参与者在这项任务的对等版本上只达到62.61%,所以区分的提示在视觉上并不明显. 它们也不与特定的分类者联系在一起,在严重的图像腐败和分配外提示下幸存了下来。 我们追踪到三个层次的视觉特质 低等纹理统计更是让轻量级多层受体匹配ResNet-50. 从图像中估计的物体布局、深度和反照率都带有源信号。 图像标题会在样式和背景中显示提示从未指定的模式偏好。 有关这些提示的一席之地提示将人的准确度提高了9.03个百分点. 这些特异性使得源分类成为测量模型之间以及真实和生成的图像之间的相似性的工具,它们告诫在人类对T2I模型的偏好评价中不要假定匿名.

blocks.en: As t2i ( t2i ) models rapidly advance and produce images of increasingly comparable visual quality ( Arena 2026 ) , whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics becomes a pressing question. Prior work has shown that generated images can be attributed to their source models ( Girish et al. 2021 ; Bui et al. 2022 ; Corvi et al. 2023b ; Guarnera et al. 2024 ) , and most recently that frontier t2i sources remain distinguishable across models and generation settings ( Xu et al. 2025 ) . These studies, however, treat attribution as the end goal and leave open what makes the sources distinguishable: the visual properties that systematically characterize each model remain largely unexplored. Characterizing these properties reveals how models differ beyond aggregate quality, supports model comparison and real-synthetic similarity analysis, and bears on evaluation protocols that assume model identities are hidden.
blocks.zh: 随着t2i (t2i) 型号的快速推进并产生越来越可比较的视觉质量的图像(Arena 2026 ),其输出是否仍然带有模式特有特征成为了迫切的问题. 以前的工作表明,生成的图像可以归结于其源模型(Girish等. 2021; Bui等编. 2022; Corvi等编. 2023b; Guarnera 等 2024 ),而最近的前沿t2i源仍然可以区分模型和生成环境(徐等 2025 ). 然而,这些研究将归属作为最终目标,并留下使来源可以区分的空洞:系统描述每个模型的视觉特性基本上仍未被探索。 对这些特性的定性揭示出模型在整体质量之外的差异,支持模型比较和真实合成相似性分析,并影响假设模型身份被隐藏的评价协议.

blocks.en: In this work, we ask whether outputs from frontier t2i models can still be reliably classified by source, and which recurring visual properties enable this distinction; we call such properties visual idiosyncrasies . We adopt a controlled source-classification task in the spirit of the “Name That Dataset” analyses of dataset bias ( Torralba and Efros 2011 ; Liu and He 2025 ) and of recent work on idiosyncrasies of llm ( Sun et al. 2025 ) : every model receives the same prompts, and a classifier must predict the source model from the image alone. We instantiate the task with four frontier open-source models ( hidream ( hidream ), flux ( flux ), hunyuan ( hunyuan ), and qwenimage ( qwenimage )) and dissect the cues that make their outputs distinguishable at the low, mid, and high levels of the visual hierarchy ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们询问来自前沿t2i模型的输出是否仍然能够可靠地按照源进行分类,以及哪些反复出现的视觉特性使得这种区分成为可能;我们称之为这种属性视觉特异性. 我们本着对数据集偏差(Torralba和Efros,2011;Liu和He,2025)进行“名称数据集”分析的精神,以及最近关于llm(Sun等,2025)的特异性的工作的精神,采取了控制源分类任务:每个模型都收到同样的提示,一个分类器必须仅从图像中预测源模型。 我们用四个前沿开源模型(隐心(隐心),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量),通量(通量(通量),通量(通量)),分解出其输出在视觉等级的低,中,高等级别(图1)上可以区分的提示.

blocks.en: A standard ResNet-50 ( He et al. 2016 ) identifies the source with 100.00% accuracy on prompts held out from training, far above the 25% chance level. This distinguishability is not a matter of visually obvious differences: on the pairwise version of the task, human participants average 62.61%, whereas ResNet-50 averages 99.99%. It is also not tied to a particular classifier, persists under severe image corruptions, and generalizes to ood ( ood ) prompts.
blocks.zh: 一项标准ResNet-50(He等人,2016年)在培训结束后的提示上以100.0%的精确度确定源,远高于25%的机会水平。 这种可区分性不是明显差异的问题:在双向任务版本中,人类参与者平均为62.61%,而ResNet-50平均为99.99%。 它也不与某个特定的分类者挂钩,在严重的形象腐败下长期存在,并概括为"被"("被")的提示.

blocks.en: We then characterize the visual idiosyncrasies behind this result at three levels. At the low level , a bank of 225 handcrafted features suffices to distinguish the models, and a category-wise analysis singles out its 38 texture features: a lightweight mlp ( mlp ) trained on texture alone reaches 99.76% four-way accuracy and generalizes to new prompts at least as well as ResNet-50. At the mid level , object layout, depth, and albedo estimated from the images each carry a source signal, from 59.50% accuracy for layout to 99.75% for albedo, and the models differ systematically in average object shape, depth range, focal length, and the spatial scale of albedo variation. At the high level , image captions expose preferences that the prompts never specify: using only tfidf ( tfidf ) features of the captions, logistic regression classifiers reach up to 68.78% and 71.78% four-way accuracy from style and background descriptions, respectively.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将这一结果背后的视觉特征分为三个层面。 在低水平上,由225个手动特性组成的库足以区分模型,而分类分析则列出其38个纹理特征:光是纹理就训练的轻量级mlp(mlp)达到99.76%的四向精度,并概括为至少新的导出以及ResNet-50。 在中层,从每个图像估计的物体布局,深度和反照率都带有源信号,布局精度从59.50%到反照率99.75%,模型在平均物体形状,深度范围,焦距,反照率变化的空间尺度方面有系统差异. 在高水平上,图像标题暴露出提示从未说明的偏好:仅使用标题的tfidf(tfidf)特性,逻辑回归分类器分别从样式和背景描述中达到68.78%和71.78%的四向精度.

blocks.en: These idiosyncrasies are useful beyond explaining the classifier. A one-sentence hint describing them raises human accuracy from 62.61% to 71.64%. Source classification also doubles as a similarity measure: leave-one-model-out prediction reveals which models resemble one another, and passing real ImageNet images through the classifiers at each level shows which model real photographs most resemble. Finally, persistent idiosyncrasies can betray a model’s identity, which cautions against assuming anonymity in human preference evaluation such as the Text-to-Image Arena. Together, these results establish source classification as an interpretable probe of how frontier t2i models differ, and visual idiosyncrasies as the properties it detects.
blocks.zh: 这些特异性除了解释分类器外,还有用. 描述他们的一分一刑提示将人的准确度从62.61%提高到71.64%. 源分类作为相似度的衡量标准也加倍:留一模一样的预测揭示出哪些模型相互相似,并通过各个级别的分类器传递出真实的ImageNet图像,显示哪些模型真实的照片最相似. 最后,持续的异想天开可能会背叛一个模型的身份,这提醒人们不要在像"文字到偶像竞技场"这样的人类偏好评价中假定匿名. 这些结果共同建立了源分类,作为可解释的探针来探究边疆t2i模型的相差,以及视同其所探测的属性的相差.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Torralba and Efros (2011) introduce the “Name That Dataset” experiment, in which a classifier that predicts which dataset an image comes from exposes dataset-specific bias. Such bias persists in modern large-scale datasets ( Liu and He 2025 ) and arises from both structural and semantic factors ( Zeng et al. 2024 ) . Our study is motivated by Liu and He (2025) and adopts the classification-based analyses of Liu and He (2025) and Zeng et al. (2024) , but targets model-specific rather than dataset-specific patterns: the classes are the source models of generated images from the same prompts, and the object of study is the visual properties that make them distinguishable.
blocks.zh: Torralba和Efros (2011年)引入了“That Dataset”实验,其中,一个预测一个图像来自哪个数据集的分类器暴露出数据集特有的偏差。 这种偏差在现代大型数据集(刘和贺2025)中长期存在并产生于结构和语义因素(曾等2024年). 我们的研究受到刘和贺(2025年)的激励,采纳了刘和贺(2025年),曾等(2024年)的分类分析,但针对的是模型特异性而非数据集特异性模式:类是同一提示所生成图像的出自源模型,所研究的对象是使其可分辨的视觉属性.

blocks.en: Synthetic images contain model-specific artifacts that enable detection ( Marra et al. 2019 ; Chai et al. 2020 ; Wang et al. 2020 ) ; these artifacts take the form of spatial patterns, frequency signatures, textures, and style cues ( Liu et al. 2020 ; Frank et al. 2020 ; Corvi et al. 2023a ; Amoroso et al. 2024 ) . Recent detectors extend to diffusion models and generalize better with pretrained features ( Wang et al. 2023a ; Ojha et al. 2023 ; Cozzolino et al. 2024a ; Liu et al. 2024b ) , and zero-shot, training-free detectors exploit compression likelihood, autoencoder reconstruction, perturbation sensitivity, and diffusion-model geometry or dynamics ( Cozzolino et al. 2024b ; Ricker et al. 2024 ; Brokman et al. 2025 ; Choi et al. 2025 ; Liang et al. 2025b ; Choi et al. 2026 ) . Attribution asks not whether an image is synthetic but which model produced it. Yu et al. (2019) show that GANs carry distinctive fingerprints, motivating attribution methods for GANs ( Girish et al. 2021 ; Bui et al. 2022 ) and for diffusion and other generative models ( Wang et al. 2023b ; Corvi et al. 2023b ; Sha et al. 2023 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; Laszkiewicz et al. 2024 ; Liu et al. 2024a ; Nguyen et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2026 ) . Most closely related, Xu et al. (2025) study source distinguishability of t2i models under varying models and settings, and Naseh et al. (2026) deanonymize arena leaderboards through prompt-conditioned image-embedding clusters. Both establish that the source is recoverable; we ask what makes it recoverable and characterize the underlying visual idiosyncrasies at three levels.
blocks.zh: 合成图像中包含能够被探测的模型特有文物(Marra等. 2019; 柴等编. 2020; Wang等2020; 这些文物采取空间图案,频率签名,纹理等形式,并有风格提示(刘等. 2020; 弗兰克等. 2020; Corvi等2023a; Amoroso等2024.). 最近的探测器可推广到扩散模型,并更普遍地利用预先训练过的特性(Wang等人,2023a; 奥日哈等. 2023; Cozzolino 等; 2024a; Liu 等; 2024b),和零发,无训练探测器利用压缩概率,自编码器重建,扰动敏感性,以及扩散-模型几何或动力学(Cozzolino等. 2024b; Ricker等编. 2024; Brokman等编. 2025; Choi等编. 2025; 梁等编. 2025b; Choi等 2026 (中文(简体) ). 归属不问一幅图像是否是合成的,而是由哪个模型产生. Yu等人(2019年)表明,GANs携带有特色的指纹,激发了GANs的归属方法(Girish等人,2021年;Bui等人,2022年)以及传播和其他基因模型的归属方法(Wang等人. 2023b; Corvi等编. 2023b; Sha等人著. 2023; 王等编. 2024; Laszkiewicz et al. 2024;刘等2024a;阮等2025;王等2026. 最密切相关的是,徐等人(2025年)研究了t2i模型在不同模型和设置下的源可分性,而Naseh等人也研究了. (2026)通过快速有条件的图像嵌入集群来去名化竞技场领跑板. 两者都确定源是可被恢复的;我们询问是什么使得源是可被恢复的,并在三个层次上描述基本视觉特征.

blocks.en: Beyond artifacts for detection and attribution, recent work characterizes properties of the generative models themselves. Sarkar et al. (2024) reveal systematic geometric inconsistencies in generated images, and Lee et al. (2026) show that underspecified prompts expose model-specific semantic preferences. In the language domain, Sun et al. (2025) use controlled classification to identify idiosyncrasies across frontier llm . We bring this classification-based lens to images and characterize the idiosyncrasies of frontier t2i models across low-, mid-, and high-level representations.
blocks.zh: 除了用于检测和归属的文物外,最近的工作还说明基因模型本身的性质。 Sarkar等(2024年)揭示出生成的图像中系统性几何不一致,而Lee等(2026年)显示,未精确的提示会暴露出模型特有的语义偏好. 在语言领域,Sun等人(2025年)使用可控分类法识别跨越边境的idiscrassies illm. 我们把这种基于分类的镜头带入图像,并描述跨越低,中,高层次代表的前沿t2i模型的特异性.

blocks.en: To test whether this distinguishability rests on visually obvious differences, we conduct a two-alternative forced-choice study on Prolific. Each of 69 participants is assigned to one of the six model pairs, studies a reference board of nine images per model labeled only as Set A and Set B, and then classifies ten new images by source ( Sec. A.3 ). Participants average 62.61% accuracy, far below the 99.99% that ResNet-50 averages over the same pairwise tasks, and vary widely ( Fig. 2 ). Visually obvious differences alone therefore cannot account for the distinguishability: the classifiers capture model-specific patterns more consistently than humans do.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这种可区分性是否基于明显可见的差异,我们对Prolific进行了两种选择的强制研究。 69名参与者每人被分配到6个模型对中的1个,研究每个模型只有Set A和Set B标签的由9个图像组成的参考板,然后按出处分类出10个新图像(Sec. A.3. 参与者平均准确度为62.61%,远远低于ResNet-50在同一双向任务上的平均99.99%,而且差异很大(图2)。 因此,仅凭可见的明显差异无法说明可辨别性:分类者比人类更一致地捕捉模型特定模式。

blocks.en: Distinguishability Persists Across Conditions
blocks.zh: 区分 跨条件的持久性

blocks.en: We vary the number of training images and retrain all classifiers ( Fig. 3 ). Accuracy on the held-out test set rises steadily with training size, and even 10 images per model give non-trivial accuracy ( e.g ., 60.96% for ResNet-50), well above chance.
blocks.zh: 我们改变训练图像的数量,对所有分类人员进行再培训(图3)。 暂停测试的准确度随着训练规模稳步上升,每个模型甚至有10个图像给出非三角精确度(例如,ResNet-50为60.96%),远远高于机会。

blocks.en: To test robustness to input degradation, we next train and evaluate ResNet-50 on images subjected to one of four corruptions: color jitter ( Krizhevsky et al. 2012 ) , Gaussian blur, blending with Gaussian noise, and resolution reduction. Classification stays nearly perfect under moderate settings and degrades only under severe ones, yet remains well above chance even at a noise blending weight of 0.8 or a resolution of 2 × 2 2\times 2 ( Tab. 3 ; examples in Fig. A12 ). Two further transformations show that the signal is neither purely global nor a fragile decoder artifact: shuffling 32 × 32 32\times 32 patches leaves accuracy at 99.43%, and re-encoding every image through an off-the-shelf vae ( vae ) leaves it above 99% ( Sec. B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了测试强性以输入降解,我们接下来会针对以下四种腐败之一的图像对ResNet-50进行训练和评价:色彩快感(Krizhevsky等,2012年),高斯模糊,与高斯噪音相混合,并降低分辨率。 分类在中度环境中几乎完美无缺,只在严重环境下才降解,但即使在噪音混合重量为0.8或分辨率为2×2 2\times 2的情况下(表3;图A12中的例子),分类仍然远远高于机会。 还有两次变换表明信号既不是纯全球的,也不是脆弱的解码器文物:打乱了32×3232\times 32补丁留下了99.43%的精度,再通过现成的活页(活页)将每个图像重新编码,使其超过99%(sec. B. 3).

blocks.en: Finally, we train on ImageNet-derived prompts and evaluate on 1,600 images per model generated from the 400 Winoground prompts ( Thrush et al. 2022 ) , which describe compositional relations among multiple entities rather than single object categories. All classifiers remain far above chance, and ResNet-50 retains 98.94% ( Fig. 4 ). The distinguishability thus extends beyond the training prompt distribution to a different kind of visual content.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用ImageNet生成的提示来训练和评价400个Winoground提示(Thrush等人,2022年)生成的每个模型的1 600个图像,这些提示描述了多个实体之间的组成关系,而不是单一对象类别。 所有分类都远远高于机会,ResNet-50保留98.94%(图4)。 因此,这种可区分性超越了培训后立即分发到另一种视觉内容。

blocks.en: Characterizing Visual Idiosyncrasies of \texorpdfstring t2i T2I Models
blocks.zh: 描述 \ texorpdfstring t2i T2I 模型的视觉特征

blocks.en: Having established that classifiers identify the source model reliably, we ask which model-specific properties make this possible. We analyze three complementary levels: low-level visual cues, mid-level visual representations, and high-level semantic realization. Qualitative examples for all three analyses are collected in Appx. F .
blocks.zh: 在确定了分类者可靠地识别出源模型之后,我们询问哪些模型具有特定特性,从而得以实现。 我们分析三个互补层面:低等视觉提示,中等视觉表现,高等语义实现. Appx收集了所有三种分析的定性实例。 费.

blocks.en: Low-Level Visual Cues

blocks.en: We construct a bank of 225 handcrafted features in seven categories, computed from each native 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 image: (i) tone (luminance statistics, dynamic range, entropy, and local contrast); (ii) color (RGB and perceptual chromaticity statistics, color histograms, inter-channel correlations, and colorfulness); (iii) texture (co-occurrence statistics, local binary patterns, and local entropy); (iv) edge and sharpness (gradient-orientation distributions, edge density, and high-frequency sharpness); (v) frequency (spectral energy distributions and oriented frequency responses); (vi) spatial organization (regional luminance and edge distributions, symmetry, and luminance centroids); and (vii) residual and noise (high-pass residual statistics, spatial autocorrelation, and residual spectral energy). The composition and definitions are given in Secs. C.1 and C.2 . A lightweight mlp trained on the full bank ( Sec. C.3 ) reaches 99.84% accuracy on the id test set and 98.55% on the ood set ( Tab. 4 ). Low-level statistics alone thus support reliable source attribution across prompt distributions, with OOD accuracy close to ResNet-50’s 98.94% ( Fig. 4 )

blocks.en: Mid-Level Visual Representations
blocks.zh: 中级视觉表现

blocks.en: We test whether the differences survive when an image is reduced to a mid-level representation. We estimate three: (i) object layout as segmentation masks from SAM 3.1 ( Carion et al. 2026 ) ; (ii) geometry as depth maps from MoGe-2 ( Wang et al. 2025a ) ; and (iii) appearance as albedo maps from DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al. 2025a ) ( Sec. D.1 ; examples in Fig. A13 ). We train and evaluate a separate ResNet-50 on each representation. All three remain above chance on the id set and lose only moderately on the ood set ( Tab. 5 ): even binary object masks reach 59.50%, depth reaches 87.72%, and albedo 99.75% (confusion matrices in Sec. D.3 ). The same ordering holds for the other classifier architectures ( Sec. D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们检验当一个形象被降低为中级代表时,这些差异是否继续存在。 我们估计有3个:(一) 物体布局是SAM 3.1(Carion等2026年)的分块口罩;(二) MoGe-2(Wang等2025a年)的几何为深度地图;以及(三) 从DiffusionRenderer(Liang等2025a年)的反照图外观。 (第D.1节;图A13中的例子)。 我们为每个代表培训和评价一个单独的ResNet-50。 三者在id set上都高于机会,在ood set上只略微地损失(图5):甚至二进制物体口罩达到59.50%,深度达到87.72%,反照率达到99.75%(Sec.D.3中的聚变矩阵). 其他分类架构的顺序相同(Sec.D.4)。

blocks.en: The representations also reveal what differs. For layout, we convert each mask into a signed distance map and average the maps per model over matched images ( Sec. D.2 ); the averaged layouts differ visibly, and qwenimage in particular renders a substantially larger average object than the other models ( Fig. 6 ). For geometry, the models occupy distinct ranges of object depth, summarized by the 5th and 95th depth percentiles of each image ( Fig. 7 ). Depth interacts with the camera, so we also compare the focal lengths estimated by MoGe-2: hunyuan has markedly shorter focal lengths, i.e ., a wider field of view, which explains how its objects can be both nearer in depth and smaller in the image. For appearance, we measure the albedo map’s fine-scale variation ratio, the share of albedo variation at fine rather than coarse spatial scales ( Sec. D.2 ). qwenimage has the highest median fine-scale variation ratio (0.253), while hidream and flux have similarly lower medians (0.190 and 0.188), indicating more spatially coherent albedo regions. hunyuan is intermediate, with a median of 0.211 ( Fig. 8 ). Mid-level representations thus offer a second, interpretable window on the visual idiosyncrasies of t2i models.

blocks.en: Applications and Implications
blocks.zh: 适用和影响

blocks.en: We illustrate three applications and one implication of the visual idiosyncrasies beyond explaining the classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们说明三种应用和一种视觉特异性,除了解释分类器之外。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Effect of a hint on human source classification. Asking participants to compare style, texture, and background raises mean accuracy from 62.61% ( n = 69 n=69 ) to 71.64% ( n = 61 n=61 ). Statistical significance: ∗ p < 0.001 {}^{*}p<0.001 (stratified permutation test).
blocks.zh: 图 9:提示对人源分类的影响. 请参与者比较样式、纹理和背景,将平均精度从62.61%(n=69n=69)提高到71.64%(n=61n=61)。 统计意义: * p < 0.001 {}^{*}p < 0.001(分层演化试验)。

blocks.en: We test whether the identified idiosyncrasies help people tell models apart. We repeat the human study of Fig. 2 with 61 new participants from the same pool and change only one thing: every question adds the hint “Please focus on comparing the images in terms of style, texture, and background,” which summarizes the cues found at the low and high levels. The hint raises mean accuracy from 62.61% to 71.64% ( Fig. 9 ); the 9.03-point gain is significant under a stratified permutation test ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and positive in five of the six model pairs ( Sec. B.5 ). The idiosyncrasies thus serve as interpretable probes that make model differences visible to people.
blocks.zh: 我们测试识别的特异性是否能帮助人们分辨出模型. 我们重复图2的人类研究,61个新参与者来自同一个池子,只改变一件事:每个问题都添加了提示“请注重在风格、纹理和背景方面比较图像”,其中总结了在低层和高层发现的提示。 该提示将平均精度从62.61%提高到71.64%(图9);在分级的演化测试(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)下,9.03分的增益是显著的,在6个型号对中,有5个是正的(Sec. B.5)。 特异性因此成为可解释的探针,使模型差异被人们所可见.

blocks.en: We assess visual similarity by comparing sources through leave-one-source-out prediction. We exclude one source, train ResNet-50 on the other three, and report its predictions for the excluded source ( Tab. 8 ). Held-out hidream is predominantly assigned to flux (93.34%). Held-out flux is assigned to hidream (58.29%) and hunyuan (31.28%). hunyuan divides almost equally between flux (49.37%) and hidream (48.49%), while qwenimage is most often assigned to hidream (76.88%). These projections describe how each unseen source is partitioned by a classifier trained on the remaining sources.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个来源的预测来比较来源来评估视觉相似性。 我们排除了一个来源,另外三个是ResNet-50列车,并报告其对被排除来源的预测(Tab.8)。 Hold-out hideream主要用于通量(93.34%)。 屏蔽通量被分配到隐蔽(58.29%)和hunyuan(31.28%)。 Hunyuan在通量(49.37%)和藏相(48.49%)之间几乎相等,而qwenimage最常被分配到藏相(76.88%). 这些预测说明,每个未见来源如何由一个经过其余来源培训的分类员进行划分。

blocks.en: Table 8: Inter-model similarity from leave-one-model-out classification. Each row gives the distribution (%) of sources predicted for the held-out model’s images by a ResNet-50 trained on the other three models. Bold marks the most frequent prediction and underline the second.
blocks.zh: 表8:从"一号出厂"分类中得出的"一号出厂"模式间相似性. 每个行都给出了通过经过其他三种模型培训的ResNet-50对被搁置模型的图像预测源的分布(%)。 粗体标出最频繁的预测,并下划出第二个.

blocks.en: Table 9: Mean predicted source probabilities (%) for real ImageNet images across representation levels. Each row averages the probabilities produced by the source classifier trained on the corresponding representation. Bold marks the largest probability and underline the second largest.
blocks.zh: 表9:真实图像网图像在代表性水平上的平均预测来源概率(%)。 每行均平均由接受相应表述培训的源分类者产生的概率. 粗体标出最大概率,并下划出第二大概率.

blocks.en: We evaluate the trained source classifiers on 10,000 real ImageNet images, using the corresponding input representation for each classifier ( Sec. A.4 ). Tab. 9 reports mean predicted probabilities. The RGB classifier predominantly assigns probability to flux (89.16%), while the handcrafted-feature classifier favors hidream (47.09%) followed by flux (42.12%). Mask predictions are more dispersed, with hunyuan receiving 30.48%. Depth, albedo, style captions, and background captions favor flux . The responses differ across representation levels and characterize the behavior of these source-trained classifiers on real images.
blocks.zh: 我们利用每个分类器的相应输入表示(Sec.A.4.),对10,000个真实的ImageNet图像对经过培训的源分类器进行评估。 附表9报告指预测的概率。 RGB分类器主要分配通量的概率(89.16%),而手动-地貌分类器则偏好隐藏梦(47.09%),其次是通量(42.12%). 口罩预测较为分散,胡同获得30.48%. 深度、反照率、样式标题和背景标题偏好通量。 不同代表级别的答复各有不同,并描述这些受源训练的分类器在真实图像上的行为.

blocks.en: Persistent visual idiosyncrasies challenge the anonymity assumed by human preference evaluations such as the Text-to-Image Arena ( Arena 2026 ) . Even when model identities are hidden, the images themselves may reveal the source, and a participant can use a trained source classifier to infer a generator and vote for or against that identity. Our human study addresses a separate question: whether a hint about the characterized cues improves human source identification; it is not an empirical test of an arena attack. Naseh et al. (2026) demonstrate leaderboard deanonymization through prompt-conditioned image-embedding clusters; our results complement this attack-oriented view by characterizing, for more recent models, the multi-level cues that make deanonymization possible.
blocks.zh: 持续的视觉特异性挑战了人类偏好评价所假定的匿名性,如"Text-to-Image Arena (Arena 2026)". 即使模型身份被隐藏,图像本身也可能揭示出来源,参与者可以使用经过训练的源分类器推断出生成器,并投票支持或反对该身份. 我们的人类研究涉及另一个问题:关于特征提示的提示是否改善了人类来源的识别;这不是对竞技场攻击的实证检验。 Naseh 等人(2026年)通过快速有条件的图像嵌入集群演示了领导板去匿名化;我们的结果补充了这种以攻击为导向的观点,为更近期的模型描绘出能够去匿名化的多层次提示.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: Images from four frontier t2i models remain almost perfectly distinguishable by source under identical prompts, across classifier architectures, under severe corruptions, and on out-of-distribution prompts, even though humans distinguish them only modestly. This robustness suggests that the distinguishing signal reflects stable properties of each model’s learned output distribution rather than superficial artifacts of prompting, resolution, or post-processing. We trace this distinguishability to visual idiosyncrasies at three levels: texture statistics that alone suffice for classification, systematic differences in object layout, depth, focal length, and albedo, and model-specific style and background preferences that captions expose. Together, these findings indicate that frontier models with similar benchmark scores still occupy noticeably different regions of image space. These idiosyncrasies make source classification an interpretable probe of how generative models differ, guide human judgment, quantify inter-model and real-synthetic similarity, and warn against assuming anonymity in model evaluation. Limitations and future directions are discussed in Appx. G .
blocks.zh: 来自四个前沿t2i模型的图像在相同的提示下,在分类架构之间,在严重腐败下,以及在分配外提示上,仍然几乎完全可以按来源区分出,尽管人类只是谦虚区分出它们. 这种稳健性表明,区别信号反映的是每个模型所学到的输出分布的稳定性,而不是表面的催化、解析或后处理文物。 我们把这种区别追溯到三个层面的视觉特异性:仅是纹理统计就足以进行分类,物体布局、深度、焦距和反照率的系统差异,以及显示标题的模型特定风格和背景偏好。 这些调查结果表明,具有类似基准分数的前沿模型仍然占据着明显不同的图像空间区域。 这些特异性使源分类成为基因模型如何相异的可解释探针,指导人类判断,量化模型间和真合成相似性,并警告在模型评价中不要假定匿名. Appx讨论了限制和未来的方向。  G.

blocks.zh: 附录A 实验细节

blocks.en: A.1 Prompt Construction
blocks.zh: A.1 快速施工

blocks.en: All source models receive the same prompts, so that prompt content is controlled. We use two prompt families: ImageNet-derived prompts, which name a single object category, and Winoground-derived prompts, which describe compositional relations among multiple entities. Example images for both families are shown in Fig. A11 .
blocks.zh: 所有源模型都收到相同的提示,这样可以控制即时内容. 我们使用两个即时的家族:ImageNet派生的提示(ImageNet派生的提示(ImageNet派生的提示(ImageNet派生的提示(ImageNet派生的提示))),这个提示(ImageNet派生的提示),这个提示(ImageNet派生的提示),这个提示(ImageNet派生的提示)取出一个单一对象类别的名称;和Winoground派生的提示(Winoground派生的提示),它描述多个实体之间的组成关系. 两个家庭的示例图像见图. A11。

blocks.en: We construct one prompt for each of the 1,000 ImageNet-1K classes ( Russakovsky et al. 2015 ) . For a class label with a primary name followed by comma-separated aliases, the primary name follows “a photo of” and the aliases are appended after “which is also known as”; the second clause is omitted when a class has no alias. Four seeds per prompt yield 4,000 images per source model.
blocks.zh: 我们为1000个ImageNet-1K类各建造一个提示(Russakovsky等人,2015年)。 对于主名后有逗号相隔别名的类名,主名后有"相相",取别名后有"又名"后附;当一类无别名时,删去了第二句. 每个速成种子4个,每个源模型4000个图像.

blocks.en: ImageNet-derived prompt template and examples Template: a photo of {primary class name} [, which is also known as {alias 1}, {alias 2}, …] Examples: a photo of stingray a photo of tabby, which is also known as tabby cat a photo of goldfish, which is also known as Carassius auratus a photo of toilet tissue, which is also known as toilet paper, bathroom tissue
blocks.zh: ImageNet衍生出即时模板和实例 Template: {初级类名}相片[,又名{别名 1},{别名 2},.] 例子:一幅"刺来"一幅"塔克比"相片,又名"塔克比"一幅"金鱼"相片;一幅"马桶组织"相片,又名"马桶纸","浴室组织".

blocks.en: Winoground ( Thrush et al. 2022 ) contains 400 examples, each a contrastive pair ( caption_0 , caption_1 ) (\texttt{caption\_0},\texttt{caption\_1}) that reverses or alters a compositional relation. We use caption_0 verbatim as the generation prompt, without any photographic or stylistic wrapper; caption_1 is not used. The same four seeds yield 1,600 images per source model, which form the ood test set.
blocks.zh: Winoground (Thrush等2022) 包含400个实例,每个实例有一个对比对 (标题_0, 标题_1) (\textt{caption_%0},\textt{caption_%1}) 来倒置或改变一个组成关系. 我们使用标题_0逐字记录作为生成提示, 不使用任何相片或风格包装; 标题_ 1 不使用 。 同样的4个种子每个源模型产生1600个图像,这些图像构成了ood测试集.

blocks.en: Winoground-derived prompt template and examples Template: {caption_0} Examples: an old person kisses a young person a bird eats a snake a bottle is in water light colored dog with dark colored cat
blocks.zh: 由 Winoground 生成的快速模板和示例 Template:{caption_0}例子:一个老人亲吻一个年轻人 一只鸟吃蛇 瓶子在水光色的狗里 有暗色的猫

blocks.zh: 图A1:人类研究中使用的示例参考板. 每个匿名集包含来自一个源模型的9个实例,由同一快取生成匹配的网格位置. 对A组和B组的模型分配在研究版本之间是平衡的。

blocks.zh: (a) ResNet-50。

blocks.zh: (b) 双层cnn。

blocks.zh: 图A2:搁置的ImageNet衍生测试集中的源分类混淆矩阵. 行表示真实源模型,列表示预测源. 每个单元格报告行正常百分比。

blocks.en: A.2 Source Classifiers and Training
blocks.zh: A.2 来源分类和培训

blocks.en: ResNet-50 ( He et al. 2016 ) is trained from random initialization with its final fully connected layer replaced by an N N -way classification head. The two-layer cnn uses two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional layers with 32 and 64 output channels, each followed by ReLU and 2 × 2 2\times 2 max pooling; the resulting feature map is adaptively average-pooled to 8 × 8 8\times 8 , flattened, and passed through a two-layer head with dimensions 4096 → 128 → N 4096\rightarrow 128\rightarrow N and an intermediate ReLU. For DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al. 2024 ) and CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al. 2021 ) , we freeze the visual encoders and train a single linear classifier on their image features.
blocks.zh: ResNet-50(他等2016年)是从随机初始化开始的训练,其最终完全连接的地层被一个N-way分类头所取代. 双层Cnn使用两相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 N和中间的ReLU. 对于DINOv2 VIT-B/14(Oquab等2024年)和CLIP VIT-B/32(Radford等2021年),我们冻结了视觉编码器,并在它们的图像特性上训练出单线性分类器.

blocks.en: We partition the 1,000 ImageNet-derived classes into 800 training classes (200–999) and 200 id evaluation classes (0–199). With four generation seeds and four source models, this yields 12,800 training and 3,200 id evaluation images, balanced across sources. No separate validation split is used: checkpoints are selected by accuracy on the training set. Feature normalization is fitted only on the training set. All 6,400 Winoground-derived images form the ood test set and are used only for final evaluation, without affecting normalization or checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 我们把1 000个ImageNet衍生课程分为800个培训班(200-999)和200个id评价班(0-199)。 有了4个代种子和4个源模型,就产生了12 800个培训和3 200个ID评价图像,在各种来源之间是平衡的。 没有使用单独的验证分拆:检查站根据训练集的准确性选择. 特色正常化只适用于培训。 所有6400出自Winoground的图像组成了ood测试集,仅用于最终评价,不影响正常化或检查站选择.

blocks.en: Each image is decoded, converted to RGB, and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 with bicubic interpolation. ResNet-50 and two-layer cnn inputs are normalized channel-wise with mean 0.5 and standard deviation 0.5; DINOv2 and CLIP inputs use their respective model-specific preprocessing. We apply no stochastic data augmentation. All classifiers are trained with cross-entropy loss and Adam ( Kingma and Ba 2015 ) at a fixed learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for 100 epochs with a batch size of 16. ResNet-50 and the two-layer cnn are optimized end-to-end, whereas the DINOv2 and CLIP encoders remain frozen. We select the checkpoint with the highest training accuracy, and report its accuracy on the held-out test sets. All experiments run on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 每个图像被解码,被转换为RGB,并被调整为224×224/224\times 224,并带有双立插. ResNet-50和两层cnn输入均按平均0.5与标准偏差0.5的通道正常;DINOv2和CLIP输入使用各自的模型专用预处理. 我们没有应用有花样的数据增强。 所有分类人员都接受过交叉性损失和亚当(Kingma和Ba 2015)的培训,固定学习率为10 - 4 10-QQ-4},分批规模为16个世纪. ResNet-50和双层cnn被优化为端到端,而DINOv2和CLIP编码器仍然被冻结. 我们以最高的训练精度选择检查站,并在停放的测试中报告其精度。 所有实验都运行在单一的NVIDIA H100 GPU上.

blocks.en: A.3 Human Study Protocol
blocks.zh: A.3 人类研究议定书

blocks.en: We recruit adult participants through Prolific and administer the study in English using Google Forms. Participants provide informed consent, confirm that they are at least 18 years old and hold at least a bachelor’s degree, and are instructed to use a desktop or laptop computer.
blocks.zh: 我们通过Prolific招募成人参与者,并使用Google表格管理英语研究. 参加者提供知情同意,确认他们至少已满18岁,至少拥有学士学位,并被指示使用台式计算机或膝上型计算机。

blocks.en: The four source models form six unordered model pairs. Each participant is assigned to one pair and learns to distinguish its two sources, anonymously labeled Set A and Set B. For each pair, we counterbalance which model is assigned to which set and cross this mapping with two instruction conditions, with and without a hint, yielding 6 × 2 × 2 = 24 6\times 2\times 2=24 between-participant study versions. Repeat participation is prevented through Prolific. New participants are automatically assigned to one of the currently least-filled versions, and returning participants are directed back to their original version.
blocks.zh: 4个源模型组成了6个无序模型对. 每个参与者被分配到一对并学会区分出其两个来源,匿名地标注了Set A和Set B. 对于每对,我们制衡被分配到哪一个模型,设定并用两个指令条件跨越这个绘图,有和没有提示,生成6×2×2=24 6\times 2\times 2=24的参与者学习版本. 通过Prolific防止重复参与。 新参与者自动被分配到目前填充最少的版本之一,回归参与者被引导回原版本.

blocks.en: We receive 150 submissions and exclude participants who answer either of two attention checks incorrectly, leaving 130 participants: 69 in the no-hint condition, analyzed in the main text, and 61 in the hint condition. All retained participants complete the ten main trials and both attention checks.
blocks.zh: 我们收到150份呈文,排除了回答两个注意中任何一个不正确检查的参与者,留下130名参与者:69名处于无内容状态,在正文中分析,61名处于提示状态。 所有留用的参与者都完成了十项主要审判,并检查注意力。

blocks.en: All stimuli are sampled reproducibly from the ImageNet-derived set. The same nine reference prompts and ten main-trial prompts are used across all model pairs, with no overlap between reference and trial prompts. Within each pair, the two models are always compared on images generated from matched prompts. Each reference board shows nine examples from each source as two 3 × 3 3\times 3 grids, with matched grid positions generated from the same prompt ( Fig. A1 ). The two mapping versions use identical images and differ only in which source is labeled Set A. The ten main trials follow a fixed prompt order and contain five query images from each source.
blocks.zh: 所有刺激措施均从ImageNet衍生的成套措施中取出。 同样的9个参考提示和10个主审提示在所有模型对上使用,参考提示和审判提示之间没有重叠. 在每一对内,总是根据相匹配的提示生成的图像来比较这两个模型. 每个参考板显示来自每个来源的9个实例为2个 3×3 3\times 3个网格,其中匹配的网格位置来自同一快取(图A1). 两种映射版本使用相同的图像,只区别于哪些来源被标记为Set A. 10个主要试验遵循固定的即时命令,包含来自每个来源的5个查询图像.

blocks.en: Participants complete one trial per page. Each page displays the assigned reference board, a query image with its prompt, and the question Which reference set is this image more likely to come from? In the hint condition, the sentence Hint: Please focus on comparing the images in terms of style, texture, and background. is added to every question. Participants select Set A or Set B; model identities and correct answers are never shown. The sequence consists of three main trials, one attention check, three main trials, one attention check, and four main trials. Each attention check reuses an image from the reference board and is presented as an ordinary trial. The primary outcome is participant-level mean accuracy over the ten main trials, with chance at 50%; attention checks and a final cue-ranking question are excluded from this computation.
blocks.zh: 与会者每页完成一次试验。 每个页面都显示指定的引用板,一个带有其提示的查询图像,以及一个问题,哪个引用集更可能来自这个图像? 在提示条件中,句子Hint:请专注于在风格,纹理,和背景等方面对图像进行比较. 在每个问题中都添加。 参与者选择Set A或Set B;模式身份和正确的答案从未显示. 其顺序由三大审判组成,一是注意检查,三是注意检查,四是主要审判. 每个注意检查参考板上的一幅图像的再利用情况,并作为普通试验提出. 主要结果是,在十项主要试验中,参与者一级的平均准确性,机会为50%;这次计算不包括注意检查和最后的提示级问题。

blocks.en: Figure A2 reports the row-normalized confusion matrices of the four classifiers on the held-out ImageNet-derived test set. The two end-to-end cnn produce strongly diagonal matrices: ResNet-50 reaches 100.00% accuracy and the two-layer cnn 98.81%, with the latter’s residual errors concentrated in flux images misclassified as hidream . Linear classifiers on frozen DINOv2 and CLIP features remain well above the 25% chance level but show broader confusion: DINOv2 most often confuses flux with hidream , whereas CLIP assigns images from several sources to flux . blocks.en: We additionally consider two transformations. Patch shuffle divides each image into non-overlapping p × p p\times p patches and randomly permutes their spatial locations; classifiers are trained and evaluated on shuffled images. Accuracy decreases from 99.43% with 32 × 32 32\times 32 patches to 92.49% with 8 × 8 8\times 8 patches. Local image statistics thus remain highly predictive after global spatial organization is disrupted, while increasingly local shuffling removes useful structure. Reconstruction encodes and decodes every image with the same off-the-shelf vae before training and evaluation. ResNet-50 reaches 100.00% with both the Stable Diffusion vae ( Rombach et al. 2022 ) and the qwenimage vae ( Qwen Team 2025 ) . The source signal therefore survives a shared learned reconstruction bottleneck and cannot be explained solely by fragile final-stage decoder artifacts.

blocks.en: C.4 Feature-Category Analysis
blocks.zh: C.4 特征-类别分析

blocks.en: We evaluate each feature category from two complementary perspectives. For category sufficiency, we train the same mlp using only the descriptors in that category. For grouped permutation importance ( Breiman 2001 ; Gregorutti et al. 2015 ) , we evaluate the trained full-bank classifier after applying a common random row permutation to all descriptors in one category while leaving the other categories unchanged; this preserves dependencies within the permuted category but breaks its association with the image and its source label. Permutations are performed separately for each dataset and training seed. Both analyses use the same train-only normalization, data splits, architecture, and checkpoint-selection procedure described above.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个互补的角度评价每个特征类别。 对于类别充足性,我们只使用该类别中的描述符来训练相同的mlp. 对于分组排列重要性(Breiman 2001;Gregorutti等,2015年),我们在对一个类别中的所有描述者适用共同的随机行排列,而对其他类别保持不变之后,对经过训练的全银行分类员进行评价;这保留了该类别内的依赖性,但打破了它与图像及其源标签的联系。 每个数据集和培训种子的分层进行。 两种分析都采用上述相同的列车普通化,数据分拆,架构和检查站选取程序.

blocks.en: Figure A3 reports the row-normalized confusion matrices for the complete feature bank and each feature category alone. The complete bank achieves 99.84% ID test accuracy, while texture, frequency, and residual and noise features alone reach 99.76%, 99.67%, and 99.33%, respectively. Tone, color, edge and sharpness, and spatial organization reach 91.27–95.20%. Class-wise performance varies with the feature category. hidream has the highest recall for edge and sharpness (98.88%) and spatial organization (98.79%), computed by pooling confusion counts across the three training seeds. Multiple feature categories therefore independently retain strong source information.

blocks.en: We visualize each feature category with t-SNE ( Van der Maaten and Hinton 2008 ) . For every category, we standardize the corresponding feature dimensions and apply t-SNE directly, without a preceding PCA projection. A single joint embedding is fitted to balanced ImageNet-derived id and Winoground-derived ood subsets, and the two domains are displayed separately with the same embedding coordinates, which makes changes in source separation across prompt distributions directly visible. As shown in Figs. A4 and A5 , texture features form a clear four-source organization in both domains. Frequency and residual-and-noise features retain partial source structure on the ImageNet-derived set, but several sources overlap substantially, and the overlap grows on Winoground. Tone, color, edge and sharpness, and spatial-organization embeddings overlap extensively and do not form four distinct clusters.

blocks.en: C.6 Texture Statistics

blocks.en: We examine the constituent statistics of the texture category in greater detail. Before aggregation, each feature is centered across the four source models within every matched seed-prompt group, and the four seeds of each prompt are then averaged for each source. This removes the component shared by images generated from the same prompt and emphasizes systematic source-conditioned offsets rather than prompt-content differences.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. A6 , the glcm statistics reveal distinct co-occurrence profiles for the four source models. hidream and hunyuan tend to occupy opposite directions on several contrast- and energy-related statistics, while flux and qwenimage exhibit different correlation and homogeneity offsets. blocks.en: The uniform lbp histograms in Fig. A8 provide a more localized view of texture. At both ( P , R ) = ( 8 , 1 ) (P,R)=(8,1) and ( P , R ) = ( 16 , 2 ) (P,R)=(16,2) , the four source models assign systematically different probability mass to specific pattern bins, with the largest deviations concentrated in a small subset of bins rather than spread over the histogram. blocks.en: We extract foreground masks, metric depth, and albedo from every generated image. For foreground masks, we use text-guided segmentation with SAM 3.1 ( Carion et al. 2026 ) . On ImageNet-derived images, we query SAM 3.1 once with the corresponding ImageNet class label and take the pixelwise union of all returned instance masks. On Winoground-derived images, we query SAM 3.1 separately with the two extracted object names and take the pixelwise union of the masks returned by both queries. In both cases, the foreground mask is defined by the alpha channel of the resulting cutout.

blocks.en: Figure A9 compares the confusion matrices obtained by ResNet-50 from RGB images and the three estimated mid-level representations. RGB classification reaches 100.00% ID evaluation accuracy. Albedo achieves 99.75%, with eight misclassified images among 3,200, and depth achieves 87.72%. Segmentation masks reach 59.50% on the 2,168 retained ID images, with qwenimage having the highest class-wise recall. These results demonstrate source information in object layout, geometry, and estimated surface appearance.

blocks.en: Table A7 reports results for all combinations of the three representations and the four classifier architectures. The ordering of the representations is consistent across every classifier and both prompt distributions: albedo is most predictive, depth intermediate, and segmentation masks least predictive. ResNet-50 gives the strongest result for each representation, but the two-layer cnn and the linear classifiers on frozen DINOv2 and CLIP features also remain above the 25% chance level. Accuracy decreases on Winoground-derived prompts, while the ordering across representations is preserved. Albedo remains highly discriminative, reaching 97.73% ood accuracy with ResNet-50 and 72.08% with a linear classifier on frozen CLIP features.
blocks.zh: 表A7报告的结果是三种表述和四种分类结构的所有组合。 每个分类器和两种迅速分布的表示的顺序一致:反照率最能预测、深度中间和分解口罩最不能预测。 ResNet-50为每个表示给出了最强的结果,但是被冻结的DINOv2和CLIP特征上的双层cnn和线性分级器也仍然高于25%的机会级. 在由Winoground生成的提示上,精确度下降,而跨表达式的顺序则得到保留. 阿尔贝多仍然极具歧视性,使用ResNet-50的精度达到97.73%,使用冷冻CLIP特性的线性分类器的精度达到72.08%.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025 ) , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al. 2025b ) , and GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking ( Hong et al. 2025 ) as captioners. Each captioner processes all 16,000 ImageNet-derived and 6,400 Winoground-derived images independently under each of the two prompts below, yielding 44,800 captions per captioner. The vlm input contains only the RGB image and the instruction; source labels, filenames, paths, and the original generation prompt are not provided. We use bfloat16 inference, greedy decoding without sampling, and a maximum of 192 new tokens. For the GLM thinking checkpoint, we suppress chain-of-thought generation and retain only the final answer text. Example captions are shown in Tab. A9 .

blocks.en: We concatenate two sparse tfidf representations ( Salton and Buckley 1988 ) implemented with scikit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 ) . The word branch uses unigrams and bigrams, while the character branch uses within-word character 3- to 5-grams. Both branches use sublinear term frequency, smoothed inverse document frequency, L 2 L_{2} normalization, a minimum document frequency of two, and at most 100,000 features; the word branch additionally applies Unicode accent stripping. For each captioner-prompt condition, both vocabularies and all inverse-document-frequency statistics are fitted only on the ImageNet-derived training captions and then held fixed for validation, held-out id testing, and Winoground ood testing.
blocks.zh: 我们提出两个稀有的tfidf表述(Salton和Buckley,1988年),用scikit-learn(Pedregosa等人,2011年)执行。 分行一词使用unigrams和bigrams,而字符分行则使用字内字符3-至5克. 两分支都使用子线性术语频率,平滑反向文档频率,L 2 L_{2}常态化,最小文档频率为2个,最多可有10万个特性;单词分支还额外应用了Unicode口音取出. 对于每个标题即时条件,词汇表和所有反向文件频率统计都只安装在ImageNet生成的训练标题上,然后固定用于验证、搁置的ID测试和Winoground ood测试。

The training set contains 12,800 captions; the held-out id , and ood sets contain 3,200, and 6,400 captions, respectively. Accuracy is the primary metric, with chance at 25%. We select the inverse regularization strength C ∈ { 0.1 , 1 , 10 } C\in\{0.1,1,10\} by ImageNet-derived validation accuracy, independently for each captioner and prompt, and evaluate the selected classifier unchanged on the held-out id and ood sets. blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our study is intentionally scoped to four open-source frontier t2i models, two English prompt families, and one default generation configuration per model. The resulting accuracies therefore establish strong closed-set distinguishability within this roster, but do not guarantee attribution to proprietary models or future checkpoints. Moreover, each source label jointly reflects model weights, architecture, training data, sampler, decoder, and any model-specific post-processing; our analyses reveal product-level visual idiosyncrasies but do not causally localize them to a particular component.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究被有意范围化到四个开源边疆t2i模型,两个英语即时家庭,以及每个模型一个默认的生成配置. 因此,由此产生的各种因素使这一名册具有很强的封闭式区分,但不能保证归属于专有模式或未来的检查站。 此外,每个源标签都共同反映模型的权重,架构,培训数据,采样器,解码器,以及任何模型特定的后处理;我们的分析揭示出产品级的视觉特异性,但不会因果地将其定位到某一特定组件.

blocks.en: Future work should disentangle these factors through controlled comparisons across checkpoints, model families, samplers, guidance scales, inference steps, resolutions, and shared decoding pipelines, while extending evaluation to open-set and continually updated model rosters. In addition, the mid-level maps and high-level descriptions are estimated by pretrained segmentation, depth, inverse-rendering, and captioning models and may inherit their biases or errors. Replication with alternative extractors, human annotations, and direct interventions on the identified visual properties would help distinguish stable generator behavior from measurement artifacts and clarify which idiosyncrasies causally support human and machine source classification.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应当通过在检查站、示范家庭、抽样人、指导尺度、推论步骤、分辨率和共享解码管道之间进行有控制的比较,将这些因素分解开来,同时将评价扩大到开放式和不断更新的示范名册。 此外,中层地图和高层次描述是通过预先训练的分块、深度、反向交接和字幕模型进行估计的,并可能继承其偏差或错误。 利用替代提取器、人类说明和对所识别的视觉特性的直接干预进行复制将有助于区分稳定的发电机行为和测量文物,并澄清哪些特征因果地支持人类和机器源分类。
